practice_questions.question_text: A binary search tree stores unique shipment weights. Larger weights are stored in left sub trees and smaller weights in right sub trees. Describe how to insert each new shipment so that left-root-right traversal lists weights from largest to smallest.
practice_questions.adaptation_rationale: Original application rewritten to be self-contained; assessed reasoning retained within cited 2027 scope.
practice_questions.solution: Create a node containing the shipment weight/record with empty children.; If the tree is empty, set the new node as root.; Otherwise begin comparison at the root.; Move left when the new weight is greater and right when smaller.; Repeat at successive nodes until the required child reference is empty.; Link the new node at that empty child, retaining the ordering rule.

marking_points.criterion: Create a node containing the shipment weight/record with empty children.
If the tree is empty, set the new node as root.
Otherwise begin comparison at the root.
Move left when the new weight is greater and right when smaller.
Repeat at successive nodes until the required child reference is empty.
Link the new node at that empty child, retaining the ordering rule.
